description: This Java source file defines the ProposingConceptException class, which extends APIException and encapsulates a custom exception related to proposed concepts in the OpenMRS HL7 module. It includes fields for a Concept object and a String valueName, along with appropriate constructors, getters, and setters.

classes.name: ProposingConceptException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an issue with a proposed concept within the OpenMRS HL7 handling logic. It contains references to a Concept object and a String valueName representing details of the proposed concept.
